learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparison of numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.action: Predicted about a million and locked
Jumped to 7h then 9h40 then 10h with food topped up
observations.outcome: 2.1 million (0.2%), 537 million (50%), 1.07 billion (100%); visible dish fills
91.5 million; smaller filled region; food feeds about 100 million so growth stalls
Corrects prediction to billion; 30 doublings, half arrived last 20 minutes; finite food ends growth; E. coli rich broth condition, many slower, food batch made up

prediction.reason: Clear order-of-magnitude alternatives expose linear intuition.

interaction.reason: Time jumps show late doubling and fixed-time food contrast exposes growth condition.

payoff.reason: Reconstructs observed counts, resolves wrong prediction and states biological/model limits.

clarity.reason: Controls, counts and dish legible; ordinary scroll exposes full reveal.

transfer.reason: Finite-resource principle and lab condition stated; no concrete separate use task.

surprise.reason: Actual million prediction overturned by billion with half arriving in last interval.

visualExplanation.reason: Dish fill changes expose time growth and finite-food contrast.

playfulness.reason: Time jumps and food switch support exploration.

practicalValue.reason: Lab conditions contextualize growth but no everyday action.

depth.reason: Doubling, late acceleration and resource-limited condition compared.

complexity.reason: Links 30 intervals, repeated doubling, percentage fill and limited resource condition.
complexity.conceptualDemand: balanced: supported linked growth relations; exponent notation introduced in reveal
complexity.interfaceBurden: low: time jumps and two food modes

whyCool: The final 20-minute jump fills the other half of the dish, then switching food conditions shrinks the ten-hour population to 91.5 million.
caveat: The finite food batch is explicitly made up; one tested desktop path provides no real bacterial prediction.
missingEvidence: Phone, keyboard-only, focus, contrast measurement, zoom/reflow and reduced motion untested
screenshots: Inline observed ten-hour unlimited and revealed limited-food states; no saved image file
